description: The image displays two side-by-side horizontal bar charts illustrating a comparison of inference times across different methods for two models, titled "Marco-o1-7B" on the left and "QwQ-32B-Preview" on the right. The vertical axes contain the categories for each method, though individual categorical labels are not printed directly on the axis; instead, a shared, rotated y-axis label reads "Inference Time (minute)." The horizontal axes measure the numerical values of these times on a linear scale. For the "Marco-o1-7B" chart, the horizontal axis ranges from 0 to 2.5 with a tick mark interval of 0.5, whereas the "QwQ-32B-Preview" chart features a horizontal axis ranging from 0 to 7 with a tick interval of 1. Below each chart, a legend defines the categories corresponding to the five bars, which are arranged sequentially from top to bottom in both charts: Baseline (light green), Fast-Solving Prompt (yellow), SFT (grey), DPO (orange), and O1-Pruner (blue). In the left chart, the longest bar represents the Baseline at approximately 2.15 minutes, followed closely by Fast-Solving Prompt and SFT both near 2.1 minutes, DPO at roughly 1.45 minutes, and the shortest bar is O1-Pruner at roughly 1.1 minutes. In the right chart, the Baseline is again the longest at approximately 6.1 minutes, followed by SFT at roughly 5.9 minutes, DPO at 5.6 minutes, Fast-Solving Prompt at 5.0 minutes, and the shortest bar is O1-Pruner at exactly 4.0 minutes. The bars are ordered to match the legend sequence rather than being sorted by length, and no individual bars are visually emphasized with additional shading or outlines.
